summary.name: Art Deco (supplemental design reference; not a directly named source-collection style).
summary.visualIdentity: Explicit cues call for axial symmetry, stepped silhouettes, sunbursts, and repeated geometric ornament. Display type is precise and geometric. Forms reveal in layers and draw toward the center, using controlled highlight sweeps rather than indiscriminate gold effects.
summary.suitableUses: Explicitly suited to ornament-led titles and posters, premium editorial layouts, and cinematic staging. Listed examples include hotel, theater, or gala openers, period title sequences, invitations, menus, product launches, and premium landing pages. Hybrid use is inferred as suitable only when black, ivory, and restrained gold stay dominant.
summary.limitations: Metallic accents must stay restrained. Avoid repeated gold shimmer, blur, sparkle, pastel film grading, and asymmetric handheld moves. Ornament must not compete with or sit behind body copy. The style is supplemental, so no source toolchain or motion-specific timing is claimed.
summary.palette: This is an authored suggestion, used only when no task, brand, or approved palette is supplied. Tokens: background #151515 (black), foreground #F6EEDC (ivory), accent_1 #B99A57 (metallic gold). Gradients are disabled, so use discrete tokens. Contrast is 15.811 for ivory on black and 6.802 for black on gold. These are two-color checks only and must be rechecked in composited frames. Supplied colors override these tokens.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicit motion cues are layer reveals, forms drawn toward the center, and masked highlight sweeps. Optional references are motion-012 (chaptered handoff) and motion-015 (narrative stepping), each needing scene-level compatibility. Motion-039 (radial burst) is optional, only when the scene contains the needed mark, and its particle burst must be restrained. Interactive delivery is not specified except combination-specific push-ins with a reduced-motion static state.
summary.audio: Audio is unspecified by the style, and no fixed genre, tempo, instrument, voice, or mandatory layer is assigned. Explicit user audio choices take priority. Without inputs, a coherent direction should be proposed with stated assumptions, not defaulted to instrumental music. Inferred: restrained sound accents may support reveals and reading holds without competing with narration.
summary.assetRequirements: Subject, exact copy, duration, aspect ratio, resolution, and frame rate are unspecified and must come from the task. No source artwork is supplied, so symmetric paths, ornaments, and any approved mark geometry must be prepared. A geometric display typeface is required, but none is named, so local fonts must load before rendering. Do not invent brand copy or marks.
summary.combinations: Art Deco alone suits ornament-led titles. Style-104 adds axial camera staging and push-ins toward sunburst centers, built as 2D SVG rather than Blender. Keep the camera on the central axis and limit gold to ornament and one sweep. Style-020 adds copy hierarchy and generous spacing for premium content. Use the Deco palette, ignore editorial taupe, and use one display face and one text face.
summary.productionApproach: Use SVG as the style renderer for paths, masks, clip paths, and stroke dashes. Use GSAP as the single motion engine with one owner per animated property. Motion is optional and needs verified seek synchronization. HyperFrames is the default pipeline, and Remotion is a fallback only when HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation exists. Register a paused GSAP timeline, seed randomness, and verify with check, snapshot, and render commands.
